name: cheap-haiku
description: Keeps Haiku 5.5 on its cheap tier. Haiku 5.5 bills 5x on every token once a request's prompt passes 100k, and its 1M window means nothing compacts until ~967k. Hooks project the next request's size and warn via systemMessage before the main thread crosses (optional hard stop via CHEAP_HAIKU_MODE=block), ask before /model haiku on an already-large context, and report Haiku subagents that crossed. Zero model tokens in the default mode.
